analyzed_vuln.description: hb_set_copy() allocates a new set via hb_set_create() but unconditionally dereferences it (`copy->set(*set)`) without checking for allocation failure / null-sentinel error state. Under the fuzzer’s forced allocation-failure path, hb_set_create can return an invalid/null-like object, and the subsequent set-copy writes through an invalid internal pointer, crashing in hb_bit_set_invertible_t::set().
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In hb-subset-fuzzer, input controls `alloc_state` (set to input size). With the PoC, allocation failure is induced during subset plan construction in hb_subset_plan_create(), which calls hb_set_copy(input->sets.drop_tables) (and similar copies). Because hb_set_copy lacks a failure check, it copies into an invalid destination set, leading to a wild write in hb_bit_set_invertible_t::set at hb-bit-set-invertible.hh:129.
